method: The trainer draws an interval from a fixed level pool and plays two synthesised notes from a random root in 12-tone equal temperament, with A4 = 440 Hz and frequency = 440 x 2^((MIDI - 69)/12). Beginner offers the major third, perfect fourth, perfect fifth and perfect octave; intermediate adds the major second, minor third and major sixth; advanced offers every interval from the minor second to the perfect octave. Ascending and harmonic questions pick a root from MIDI 55-71 (G3-B4) and descending questions from MIDI 60-76 (C4-E5), so both notes stay within a comfortable listening range. A question never repeats the previous interval while the pool holds more than one choice. Answers are checked by semitone count; the score tracks questions asked, correct answers, current streak and best streak, and accuracy is correct divided by asked, rounded to a whole percent. Notes are generated locally with the Web Audio API and a short triangle-wave envelope: no audio files, no microphone input and no network requests. This is interval recognition practice only, not absolute-pitch, tuning or intonation training.
